candidate_relations.label: chronic high-grade myelodysplastic syndrome
candidate_relations.reason: The reference diagnosis is a composite: cutaneous LCH plus concurrent evolving AML. C001 names only the antecedent MDS, missing both the skin biopsy-proven langerin-positive LCH and the AML transformation component. MDS is part of the clinical context but is not the final diagnostic object requested.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Captures only the pre-existing hematologic background (MDS/RAEB); omits the cutaneous LCH component entirely and does not reflect the clonal evolution toward AML indicated by 10-15% myeloblasts and shared somatic mutations

case_quality_flags: Composite diagnosis requires two simultaneous entities (cutaneous LCH + evolving AML); single-entity candidates will inherently be partial
Shared clonal mutations (ASXL1, IDH2, STAG2) across skin and marrow are key evidence for clonal relationship between LCH and AML
